Players Committee card image of [[Kit Fisto]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to an [Episode I] site (-2 if underwater). Landspeed = 2. Once per turn, may use 1 Force (or place your combat card here in Used Pile) to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 5.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/kitfisto.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/kitfisto.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
